name: agent-crew
description: A crew of AI agents (PM, critic, architect, QA, frontend, backend, DB, security) that turns an idea for a small-business tool into a working, tested project, on the stack that fits it. All state lives in .crew/ in the project.

budget_cap_usd.title: Spending cap (USD) — only for pay-per-use
budget_cap_usd.description: Leave 0 on a Claude subscription: your plan's limits apply and nothing is capped. Set an amount only if you pay per use (API key, cloud provider, or a model billed in usage credits); the crew then stops a project when its spend reaches it.

stack_profile.title: Stack
stack_profile.description: auto: the crew picks the stack that fits the idea (or detects the one your project already uses) and writes its own rules for exactly those technologies. tanstack: a ready-made starter (TanStack Start, Drizzle, PostgreSQL) with rules that ship with the plugin.

autonomy.title: Autonomy
autonomy.description: full: the crew only stops for escalations. review: the crew shows the brief and waits for your approval before building.

brief_review_minutes.title: Brief review wait (minutes)
brief_review_minutes.description: In review autonomy, how long a host UI waits for your brief approval before continuing.
